observations: A blue table tennis table with a net installed.
The brand name 'Nashua' is printed on the corner of the table surface in photo 0.
The table has a black metal undercarriage with caster wheels.
The legs are partially wrapped in white protective plastic sheeting.
The table is positioned on a paved outdoor patio area.
The table edge appears thick, characteristic of indoor MDF or wood-core tables.
Watermark 'OBILA CONCEPTS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible on the image.

claims.claim: can stay under the rain, sun, snow; it can withstand all weather conditions
claims.evidence: The photo shows a thick-edged table typical of indoor models; outdoor tables usually have thin melamine or aluminum composite tops. Material cannot be confirmed without a close-up of the edge.

risks.risk: Indoor model sold as outdoor (will warp and rot if left outside)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the table's edge showing the core material (wood/MDF vs. composite).

risks.risk: Surface warping or dead spots affecting play
risks.proof: A video of a table tennis ball being dropped from a consistent height across various points on the surface to check for uniform bounce.
risks.if_unproven: as having a warped or uneven surface

risks.risk: Photo may be a stock or showroom image rather than the specific unit for sale
risks.proof: A photo of the table with a handwritten note showing the current date and the buyer's name.
risks.if_unproven: as a used unit with significant cosmetic wear

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the table edge to identify the core material.
Photo of the underside of the table panels.
Video of a ball bounce test across the surface.
Photo of the table with a handwritten note of today's date to verify possession.
response.reason: The brand and item type are clearly identified from the photo. While the 'all-weather' claim is suspicious given the visible construction, the item can be priced as a standard indoor Nashua table in used condition.
